title: The duel’s unequal outcome
intro: Sarpedon answers the taunt. Tlepolemus dies; the wounded Sarpedon is carried away with the spear still in his thigh.

notes.text: ἐλθόντα: 2aor ptc acc sg of ἔρχομαι, with σε from 644. “Not even if you are very strong”; ἐσσι = εἶ.
δαμάζω / δάμνημι, subdue: aor pass ptc acc sg; shortened stem δμη-. ὑπ᾽ ἐμοί, “by me.”
περάω, pass through: fut act inf, still dependent on ὀΐομαι (644); Ἀΐδαο gen sg of Hades.
ἀγός, leader; αὐδάω, speak: 3sg impf.
ἀπόλλυμι, destroy: 3sg aor. ἀφραδίη, folly / thoughtlessness: dat pl, cause; Laomedon's folly explains the earlier sack.
ἔρδω, do: aor act ptc acc sg; “him who had done good service,” Heracles.
ἐνίπτω, rebuke / abuse: 3sg reduplicated aor; κακῷ μύθῳ, “with harsh words.”
ἀπέδωκε, 3sg aor of ἀποδίδωμι, pay / give what is due; κ → χ before ἵππους. The promised horses were withheld.
“For which”; εἵνεκα = ἕνεκα, + gen. τηλόθεν, from far away.
φόνος, death / slaughter; κήρ, doom: acc sg, with μέλαιναν, black. These are the subjects of the following inf.
τεύχω, bring about: fut mid inf, passive sense here, “will be brought about by me,” with σοὶ (652), “for you.” ἐμέθεν = ἐμοῦ.
δάμνημι, subdue / kill: 2aor pass ptc acc sg, referring to Tlepolemus, the understood subject of δώσειν.
εὖχος, triumph / glory; ψυχή, life. κλυτόπωλος, famed for horses: dat sg with Hades; “glory to me, life to Hades.”
ἀνέχω, hold up / raise: 3sg 2aor mid, stem σχε-. μείλινος, ash-wood, with ἔγχος.
ἁμαρτῇ, at the same time; δόρυ, spear: nom pl.
ἀΐσσω, dart: 3pl aor. αὐχήν, neck: acc sg; “struck the middle of the neck.”
αἰχμή, spear-point; διαμπερές adv., right through; ἀλεγεινός, painful / grievous.
Erebus-dark / murky night; death's darkness covers Tlepolemus' eyes.
μηρός, thigh. βάλλω: epic 3sg plup act, “had struck”; final -ν is not a 1sg ending here.
διασεύω, rush through: 3sg aor mid. μαιμάω, be eager / rage: pres ptc nom fem sg, epic expanded form; the spear-point is personified.
ὀστέον, bone: gen sg. ἐγχρίμπτω, press close / graze: aor pass ptc nom fem sg + gen; “grazing the bone.”
πατήρ = Zeus, Sarpedon's father; λοιγός, destruction; ἀμύνω, keep off: unaugmented 3sg impf.
βαρύνω, weigh upon: unaugmented 3sg impf. ἕλκω, drag: pres pass ptc nom neut sg with δόρυ; the spear drags as he is carried.
ἐπιφράζομαι, consider / think of: 3sg aor mid. Neither this nor ἐνόησε is a perfect.
ἐξερύω, pull out: aor act inf; gen of separation, “from the thigh.”
ἐπιβαίνω, step upon / mount: 3sg root aor opt; purpose, “so that he might mount [the chariot].”
σπεύδω, hurry: pres ptc gen pl; partitive with οὔ τις (665), “none of those hurrying [to help].”
ἀμφιέπω, attend to / busy oneself about: pres ptc nom pl; “so hard pressed were they as they tended him.”
ἑτέρωθεν, on the other side; ἐϋκνήμις, well-greaved: nom pl (κνημίς, greave).
τλήμων, enduring / steadfast: acc sg, with θυμός, spirit; from the endurance root τλα-/τλη-.
μαιμάω, surge eagerly / rage: 3sg aor; ἦτορ, heart (neut); οἱ, “his.”
μερμηρίζω, ponder: 3sg aor; φρήν, mind: acc sg. The alternatives follow next page.
